run_libri_labels_extract: run the python script to extract LibriSpeech transcriptions from a TSV file into .ltr and .wrd output files
run_libri_labels_cli: run the python CLI tool with a TSV input path, output directory, and output name to generate label files
create_transcription_lookup: create a dictionary that maps directory paths to their transcription text files for audio utterances
generate_ltr_wrd_files: generate letter-level and word-level transcription output files from a LibriSpeech TSV dataset index
parse_trans_txt: parse .trans.txt files to map audio file names to their corresponding transcription text
